changelog: Settings entry: the settings screen is now resolved without relying on the fragment tree alone. CloudStream 4.8.0+ renders only the settings family with Compose, so the visible Compose screen inside the navigation host is used as a second, independent route - the entry now also appears on hosts where the fragment walk cannot see the destination.

Settings entry: row placement retries longer, removes itself when a settings sub-page or another tab is opened, and still falls back to a compact pinned entry if the list container never accepts the row.
Gear sheet now reports the live diagnostics of the entry (route, container, attempts, state) next to the version, so the behaviour can be verified without log files.
Fixes a resolver abort: one misbehaving fragment could previously cancel the whole settings-screen search.
